evals.name: required-later
evals.prompt: Every book must eventually have a catalog number. We have existing books and older writers that cannot provide one yet. Show how we would know when it is safe to enforce the rule.
evals.expected_output: Stage the change; existing books and writes survive the upgrade. Enforce non-null only after old writers are retired and the backfill is complete.
assertions: Checks a representative book survives a previous-schema upgrade.
Separates nullable rollout and backfill from the non-null constraint.
Does not describe a destructive down migration as restoring the new values.
